item: 1.31 ask-card preview box keeps one height while hovering the options
branch: askPrevHtml() (js/50-blocks.js) lays every option's preview plus the no-preview sentence into the box as invisible, fold-capped sizers in one grid cell (css/40-cards.css .ask-prev); paintPreview fills the visible pre, which stretches to the cell. Live (85-cards.js) and replay (55-replay.js) both build the box through it.
provenance: The permission_request / AskUserQuestion shape is fixture 92's (the preview field is real, CLI 2.1.220 replay-sample.jsonl); the option previews here are synthetic, chosen for three different heights plus none. Reproduced before the fix in the sandbox panel 2026-10-26: hovering 0→1→2→3 moved the list 365→328→365→346 px as the box went 37→74→37→55 px.

steps.note: 1 — a question whose options carry previews of different heights (one line, folded ten lines, none, two lines) sits at the bottom of a scrolled log (after a 1.5 s settle, so an earlier fixture's late timer cannot land mid-measure)

steps.note: 2 — hover down the list and back (0,1,2,3,Other,0,1): the box height and the list's position never change — each sample also records log.scrollTop / scrollHeight / child count, and a MutationObserver tapes #log into window.__mut102 for the sweep only: two full-suite runs saw the list jump 76-155 px with the box height unchanged (something else growing the log mid-sweep, not reproduced alone or in a subset), so a recurrence names its cause. NAMED 2026-10-26 (third recurrence): a live CLI reply streamed into a .turn-body mid-sweep (a git-status answer, the sandbox's real CLI sharing the page) while the box stayed 82 px — harness noise, not this fix — its source was fixture 04's sendTurn('what is the status?') going through the REAL bridge, stubbed the same day; if the list check fails with the box-height check green, read window.__mut102 before suspecting the box
steps.setup: window.__m102 = null; window.__mut102 = []; if (window.__mo102) window.__mo102.disconnect(); window.__mo102 = new MutationObserver(function(ms){ ms.forEach(function(m){ [].forEach.call(m.addedNodes, function(n){ if (n.nodeType === 1) window.__mut102.push((m.target.className||m.target.id||m.target.tagName) + ' <- ' + n.tagName + '.' + n.className + ' ' + String(n.textContent).slice(0,60)); }); if (m.type === 'attributes') window.__mut102.push('attr ' + m.attributeName + ' on ' + (m.target.className||m.target.id)); }); }); window.__mo102.observe(log, {childList:true, subtree:true, attributes:true, attributeFilter:['class','hidden','style']});

expect.why: DISCRIMINATING: the preview box keeps one height on every hover
DISCRIMINATING: the option list does not move under the pointer
the box still paints the hovered option's preview
